## Caveats

* All numbers are on **synthetic** images. Real screenshots differ (fonts, branding, anti-aliasing); expect lower accuracy until a pilot measures it. Low-confidence predictions are never used on their own.
* The fixed test set is reused for every candidate comparison, so repeated selection slightly overstates the improvement; weak categories are chosen on the validation set to limit this.
